entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system (Abstract, Overview, Details) to achieve a 91% token reduction and significant task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine built from text, code, and conversations. It supports local extraction and embedding models, distilling session lessons into durable, searchable permanent memory.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication for sub-300ms recall. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, videos, and code via an MCP server.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain supports keyword retrieval, semantic search, and synthesis with citations through a typed knowledge graph. It exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections to facilitate reference extraction.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the LongMemEval benchmark. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers client implementations in Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents, serving as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper. Implemented as a FastAPI server, it supports managed or Docker deployments and integrates with MCP and Cursor-compatible clients.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent memory provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 supported LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond local data storage. It includes episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes vector search on Qdrant and structured facts to manage persistent data. It features a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and includes an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that provides filesystem-first artifacts like traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool automatically indexes history from 34 different coding agents, including session data already stored on disk. It uses an MCP server to provide recall of past sessions while redacting sensitive keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers and any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistence across different sessions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur functions as a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams on local disk. It utilizes an MCP server to enable multi-agent tool portability through hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and local embeddings.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets across multiple harnesses including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports real-time ingestion from platforms like GitHub and Obsidian, achieving 97.6% accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that captures agent decisions and preferences directly from session transcripts. It operates without cloud dependencies, utilizing hybrid BM25 and vector search via native plugins and MCP integration.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package family that includes an SDK, CLI, and a dedicated Hermes adapter.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long-context inference for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw through prefix-cache sharing and context reordering. It provides a context index for deduplication and cache-aware scheduling across engines like vLLM and llama.cpp.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled memory. It includes a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps and provides primitives for tracking and resolving contradictions.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via host-specific plugins.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis featuring citations, links, and provenance for source-grounded knowledge. It stores data in SQLite with rebuildable Markdown projections and supports portable archives for merging wiki data across sessions.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs for local-first storage using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that automates configuration for major coding agent clients using GGUF models.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with specific evidence packets per query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text ranking, and graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This plugin reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer stores durable context in plain Markdown files rather than native agent memory. It uses hash-checked proposals and receipts for reviewed updates, supporting coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database with a 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of all prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log to ensure recall transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail enables agents to manage payments using a TypeScript SDK and an MCP server for budget-bound wallets. It supports USDC and stablecoins across EVM and Solana chains without requiring a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP configurations to facilitate knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation through detached model calls for local capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents. It integrates native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and uses a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory storage and retrieval. It provides tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This tool provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers long-term memory with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval modes, including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project provides 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve information integrity.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based utility focuses on memory hygiene by using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting facts within markdown files. It generates evidence-cited JSON diffs for review and leverages a local git repository to track or revert changes to the agent's knowledge base.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning by applying TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles to software development. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured methodology for agentic software engineering.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts through a dedicated CLI. It supports native agent runtime via the DeepSeek Harness and exports designs into formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a standardized foundation for cybersecurity operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It includes a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout adjustments.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It features a master router and connector skills to manage escrow, verification, and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process for verification. It offers five optional voice profiles and supports rewrite, detect-only, and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or user accounts. The skills are designed for immediate use across various assistants including Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe support for agentskills.io using remote registries via Git and S3 sources. It provides sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools to read bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite or Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun without background services, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work, decisions, and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for VPS production and automation in Portuguese. It supports integrations with messaging platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports Chainlink services like CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, and installs via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX image and video generation. The suite includes eight specialist skills and supports polling and webhooks for BFL API tasks.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills with instructions linked to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting new skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that compiles natural language into reviewable files using a deterministic compiler. It provides integrity verification for execution traces and supports multiple AI model providers.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills with a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features using TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification, this project serves as a centralized hub for browsing and installing community skills. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token consumption and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling, habits, and study blocks. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like semgrep and bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram, supporting 97 different languages. It claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompt quality across five specific dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Go, and Rust. It incorporates a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine for persistent task state management and multi-story task decomposition.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project adds persistent memory and session management to agents like Claude Code, enabling worktree recovery and multi-session reconciliation. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides tools for skill scaffolding and eval auditing.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to add reproducible demo GIFs to repositories by generating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, web apps, and libraries, ensuring output files are optimized to stay under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files while validating them against runtime-specific profiles. It monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift and uses CI-friendly exit codes to prevent broken deployments.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It gates updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library without external daemons.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed for content creation workflows, including an E-commerce Material Studio and structured data extraction.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages environment-specific path syntax and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures deterministic file routing and runtime compatibility without requiring new software installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This suite provides skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, supported by a workspace Postgres database and scheduled tasks. It includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication and is compatible with agentskills.io standards.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent ecosystems for handling monetized web resources.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 signatures and offers a public API for certificate verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables users to earn or pay USDC on the Base network for support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It facilitates listing bounties and buying context, with payments automatically distributed upon human approval of a winning answer.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for structured web data extraction across 31 platforms. It utilizes a hosted MCP server to support clients including Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests while producing structured analysis that includes core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a structured debate format between bullish and bearish researchers, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents who approve final trades.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration platform that governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, supporting both local Node.js and Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities. It ensures persistent background execution using tmux and provides secure sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is designed to manage payment-required states for paid APIs by detecting HTTP signals during agent orchestration.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms supported by durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage and visualize agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task statuses and a live stream of agent reasoning and tool execution. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, and infrastructure roles. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles through a integrated Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code, specifically orchestrating TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations. It manages structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking to optimize agent performance.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an arena where two autonomous AI companies, powered by nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, compete for GitHub stars. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack that uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies. It is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes and other coding agents by pre-indexing files. It includes an MCP server and automatically synchronizes the index on every file change to ensure agents access up-to-date data.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. Users can visualize their consumption data and optionally submit it to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports over 40 AI tools and features multi-device synchronization with historical breakdowns by project and model.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting providers. It assists developers in building better user interfaces by integrating directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications using Hermes Agent. It features 36 autonomous skills for deployment and monitoring, requiring human approval only for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and ASCII art. Developers can modify banner colors and spinners using various aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk styles.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This project establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run without external processes or OAuth. It also includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that flags ambiguous tools and schema mismatches in agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It supports multiple file formats and generates SARIF reports for integration with CI and GitHub Code Scanning.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various chat platforms, including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code, to enhance agent memory capabilities.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, alongside automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework designed for creating scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configuration. It enables seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local tools, memories, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing capabilities for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry and offers two monitoring modes: zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Operating as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default, this project focuses on generating online revenue using Hermes Agent. It requires explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contracts.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled personal assistant runs fully offline without API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, featuring adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional memory storage and semantic search. It includes tools for adding, deleting, and searching memories, as well as a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling configurations across multiple agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It allows users to perform one-click switching between different API providers within a single interface.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with file access and user approval for agents like Hermes and OpenClaw. It extends accessibility by providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface offers 1:1 feature parity with the Hermes CLI for use on web browsers and mobile devices. It utilizes a three-panel layout for chat, sessions, and workspace browsing, built entirely with Python and vanilla JavaScript.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app facilitates the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent via local backends or remote API connections. It features a streaming chat UI with markdown support and provides management for 14 toolsets, memory systems, and environment profiles.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard serves as a unified configuration hub for Hermes and other runtimes across ten communication platforms like WhatsApp and Matrix. It includes a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent coordination. The interface integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated inspector panel for managing skills and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents, including Hermes and Codex, as a desktop or self-hosted application. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for system repair and shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs through an embedded terminal.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The UI supports memory management and LaTeX rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser tabs to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes using intelligent tab-scoping controls. It features site-aware drafting capabilities in 31 writing environments and supports multi-agent thread synchronization.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details, file attachments, and private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code alongside custom LLM model routing. It provides a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency while monitoring live code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that allows users to search prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across local agent histories. It builds a local search index without telemetry to track per-session token burn and estimated API-equivalent costs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication with cloud-based agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports profile and skill management alongside a kanban board for organizing agentic work and tasks.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard runs locally as a Telegram Mini App with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install desktop solution for Windows runs via portable Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring dashboard focused on session activity and cost tracking for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
